purpose: A candidate whose rationale cites entries at the signal-session close while the registered version enters at the next open. The critic reports causal_leakage located in the rationale, with no affected definition element. The finding is advisory for DRAFT_TO_EVALUATING and blocking for EVALUATING_TO_PAPER.

edits.value: The entry rule is supported by a trade table whose entries are taken at the close of the signal session; the table shows the average gain per trade that this revision expects.

evidence.content: Earlier hypothesis note: the weakness threshold of 32 admits entries that threshold 30 misses.

findings.description: The rationale cites a table of entries at the signal close. The registered version enters at the next open, so the claimed gain per trade does not describe it.
proposed_tests: Compare the signal-close entry table with a next-open entry replay under the frozen policy.
